material.description: Live JIT probe (dispatch 1792264399986): mechanic_checks::structure_damage run through the gate binary passes (beacon hp drops within 100 ticks with an enemy skirmisher in range), so U1-U3 are known. The CI duel-routes job differs: it runs oscraftd on scenarios/duel-routes for 200 ticks and reads /state?map=ci. That path is not probed here: no helper builds a room from the duel-routes image (checks.rs test_room uses default data), and ci-log for run 38951283476 failed (dispatch 1792264354644). Also mechanic_checks.rs is not declared in rust/gate/src/main.rs, so structure_damage is never run by the gate. blocked_by: sim-structure-damage-scenario.
